_comment: Copy this file to NCentralITGlueDeviceSync.config.json next to the script and fill it in. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Secrets (N-central token, IT Glue key, passwords) do NOT go in this file.

NCentral._comment: ServerUrl is just the https address of N-central. AssetDetails reads serial number, make, model, OS, MAC and IP per device (one API call each, cached AssetRefreshHours, at most MaxAssetLookupsPerRun per run). Exclude* take N-central ids (or customer names) to leave out on purpose, e.g. your own internal customer.

CustomerNameMap._comment: Only for a customer whose names can't be made the same: "N-central customer name": "IT Glue organization name". Leave empty so every name must match exactly.

Sync._comment: UpdateFields: what the sync keeps equal to N-central on existing configurations (name, hostname, serial-number, configuration-type, location, operating-system-notes, manufacturer, model, mac-address, primary-ip). New configurations get everything. RetiredDeviceAction: Report (default) or SetStatus (sets RetiredStatus). BlockAllOnMismatch true = make no changes at all while any device doesn't match a customer/site.

LocalModel._comment: Optional local AI model in Ollama (off unless Enabled is true or the script is run with -UseLocalModel). It only suggests matches for devices the serial number and name checks couldn't match, and IT Glue configurations that look retired. AutoLink true + confidence >= AutoLinkConfidence = linked; >= ReviewConfidence = held and reported for a person; lower = treated as no match. Endpoint must be on this computer unless AllowRemoteEndpoint is true. ApprovedMatches / RejectedMatches: {"N-central device id": "IT Glue configuration id"}, copied from the alert. KeepConfigurationIds: IT Glue ids never to suggest archiving.

Webhook._comment: Only used when NotificationMethods includes "Webhook". Receives a JSON POST.
